set.body:
Objective
Make stencil execution policies, coordinate arithmetic, validation, mutability, and allocation contracts real before a stable stencil artifact.

Acceptance criteria
- No accepted public execution-policy option is ignored.
- Logical coordinates and reflection periods use checked wide arithmetic.
- Empty spatial source extents fail during preparation with a typed documented error.
- Prepared executor thread safety and reusable workspace ownership are explicit.
- Direct, reference, prepared, immutable-source, and mutable-source paths agree on JVM and Scala.js.
- Allocation tests prove no per-sample boxing for promised primitive paths.
- The module remains 0.x or unpublished until all child tickets close.
set.title: EPIC: Stabilize ravel-stencil on an explicit 0.x contract
